newsitem.title: UK: PRESS DIGEST - London Evening Standard - Nov 1.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - London Evening Standard - Nov 1.

text.p: Prepared for Reuters by The Broadcast Monitoring Company

Wandsworth Council published today a list of council tenants who have been successfully prosecuted for a variety of anti-social offences, in a bid to promote good behavour on its estates. Civil liberties groups have called the scheme outrageous.
WATCHDOG BITES AT CHARGES TO RIVALS

Another battle between BT and Oftel looks likely, as Oftel is due to announce a set of proposals to cap the amount of money BT can make from charging other telecoms companies for the use of its lines.
ANGLO'S LONRHO DEAL SET FOR EURO PROBE
The European Commission is to examine Anglo American's purchase
of 18.3 percent of Lonrho, over fears it may have an anti-competitive effect on the world platinum market.
DOLLAR SPURT IS JUST THE JOB FOR STERLING
Sterling reached a 23-month high against the Deutschmark today, following the resurgent U.S. dollar.
BEWILDERED BY THE U.S. STYLE AT TAMARIS

The extent to which British nursing homes operator Tamaris can continue to prosper while exploiting American-style sale and leaseback finance, is being questioned by two leading industry analysts, independent consultant William Fitzhugh and Laing & Buisson's Paul Saper.
